scripts.pack: npm run build && cd dist && rm -f ../site.zip && zip -rq ../site.zip .
scripts.deploy: npm run build && cd dist && npx zeabur@latest deploy
scripts.check:fidelity: vite build --ssr scripts/ssr-entry.js --outDir dist-ssr && node scripts/compare.mjs
scripts.check:hydration: npm run build && npm run build:dom && node scripts/hydration-check.mjs
scripts.check: npm run check:assets && npm run check:fidelity && npm run check:interactions && npm run check:hydration
